text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help you produce short-form AI TikToks quickly and consistently.

With 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, and AI workflows, I’m comfortable following structured processes carefully and working at a fast pace. While my background is more on the AI and automation side than traditional video editing, I’m very used to taking a set of instructions, executing them reliably, and iterating quickly to meet a tight production rhythm.

One relevant project I completed was an LLM evaluation harness for Quillstack in edtech. I built a regression suite that grades tutor-bot answers against a 400-item rubric before each release, and it achieved a judge-human agreement kappa of 0.71 while catching 2 regressions before release. That work required attention to detail, consistency, and the ability to follow a repeatable process exactly—skills that translate well to a content workflow with set steps and fast turnaround.

What makes this role appealing to me is the clear, systemized production process. If your Google Doc lays out the steps, I can follow them carefully and keep output moving at the pace you need. I’m comfortable working in English, sticking to instructions, and handling repetitive production tasks without losing focus on quality. I also understand the importance of speed in short-form content, especially when the goal is to deliver multiple pieces each day and keep the workflow moving efficiently.

I’d be excited to learn your exact process, match your editing style, and contribute to a reliable daily content pipeline. If you’re looking for someone who is dependable, quick to adapt, and serious about following directions precisely, I’d be glad to discuss the role further.
